_doc: Size classes of the hart3 weapons (tools/heroweapon/art_hart3.py); merge into tools/relics/weapon_classes.json 'weapons', then run tools/relics/audit_weapon_scale.py --write.

vassal_book.why: a heavy spellbook held upright: measured by its largest dimension (the cover 0.78 block tall in the cube, the loose pages and ribbon beyond it; 0.72 of that in the third person hand)

vassal_carriage.why: a small carriage held upright on its wheels, nose to the right: measured by its largest dimension (1.0 block long in the item cube)

vassal_fan.why: a held war fan: measured by its largest dimension (the span, about 0.9 blocks)

vassal_katana.why: a katana: the class length 1.4 to 1.8 blocks, tip bent toward the edge (-x)

vassal_scythe.why: a tall scythe: the class length 2.0 to 2.6 blocks, head at least 0.6 across (the hook is 0.9)
